question: A sum of ₹x will amount to ₹38,637 at 8% p.a. in 2(3)/(4) years, when the interest is compounded annually. The value of x is:
solution:
Given:

Rate of interest (R) = 8%

Time (N{A over B} ) = 2(3)/(4) years

Concept used:

In the case of compound interest, Amount (A)

⇒ P(1 + R/100)N (1 + {{{A over B} × R} over 100})

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N{A over B} = Time in years

Calculation: 

According to the concept,

38,637 = x (1 + 8/100)² (1 + {{{3 over 4} × 8} over 100} [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] )

⇒ 38,637 = x (108/100)² (1 + 6/100)

⇒ 38,637 = x (27/25)² (1 + 3/50)

⇒ 38,637 = x (27/25)² (53/50)

⇒ (38,637 × 50 × 25 × 25)/(27 × 27 × 53) = x

⇒ 31250 = x

⇒ x = 31,250

**∴ The value of x is 31,250.**
